GUNBREAKER_MOD_POWER_NO_MERCY_POWER.desc: Strength that will be lost after a limited number of turns.
Whenever Cartridge is spent, generates its matching follow-up card in hand.
GUNBREAKER_MOD_POWER_HEART_OF_STONE_STRE: Strength that will be restored at the end of this turn.
GUNBREAKER_MOD_POWER_ROYAL_GUARD_POWER.d: Attackers lose Strength for their next turn whenever they attack you.
